body:
The bounded guarded migration is accepted. This is the reviewed public interface freeze for #108.

Validation: `direnv exec . ./check.sh --candidate HEAD --fresh --jobs 2` passed at exact commit `2f89f8651843797822efbb7da038311ab3d9f04d`: 2255 modules compiled from fresh project outputs, followed by the exhaustive audit (2256 modules checked). Transitive axiom union: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. Total check time3073.45s. Exact `--verify-candidate HEAD` passed in fresh mode. Independent Standards and Spec passed with zero unresolved findings, both for the three-issue batch from `3bbf808` and enclosing integration from `a95a5ef`. The #107 retained-intent assessment also found no unresolved mismatch; its provenance is this session's approved bounded migration, not a claim to recover every original historical discussion.

Snapshot: `2f89f8651843797822efbb7da038311ab3d9f04d`. The candidate preserves the original left-path strategy, completes arbitrary-path source associativity and transport-composition reuse, derives fresh-operation substitution, and interprets the same generated associator with ordinary groupoid and faithful/ineffective C4 observations. The old Typed interface and #106 archive remain available. No general equality between the new and legacy higher transport certificates is claimed.

Public handoff: [guarded dependent-authoring repair](https://github.com/VladimirMarko/conaled/blob/2f89f8651843797822efbb7da038311ab3d9f04d/docs/research/guarded-dependent-authoring-repair.md). Core public mechanisms are Presented.eliminate/beta and the presented-tail substitutions/squares, SourcePath with ReflexiveRoot and PathArguments, Tm.leftConcatSub, and existing contextual transport rules. Examples.GuardedLeftAuthoring, GuardedLeftConcatenation, GuardedLeftAssociativity and GuardedLeftTransportComposition supply checked callers. The wrong-endpoint diagnostic is retained under experiments/dependent-congruence-resumption. Earlier guarded/reference, model, frontend and Agda-artifact examples in this exact public snapshot are allowed inputs; the complete repository tree fixes their versions. This is an inventory entry point, not a restriction on permitted generic public helpers.

In an isolated checkout at the snapshot, enter the pinned environment with direnv. Focused command: `direnv exec . lake build Examples.GuardedLeftAuthoring Examples.GuardedLeftAssociativity Examples.GuardedLeftTransportComposition`. Full acceptance: `direnv exec . ./check.sh --candidate HEAD --fresh --jobs 2`. The archived wrong-endpoint .lean.txt fixture is deliberately rejected and is outside the production import closure.

The known associativity repair is assisted framework work, not an independent retest or productivity result. #108 may now begin under its independent-author protocol. Its new unexposed author must select a different extant theorem after the freeze, obtain the separate solution-free scope check, then follow the prospective 40-cycle cap and archive-before-feedback requirements. No theorem was selected or prepared by this repair. New named operations can still require a fresh-substitution theorem; all investigation/helper/repair work counts in the trial.


Public capability inventory at this snapshot (paths relative to repository root):

| Capability | Public entry points | Provenance and boundary |
|---|---|---|
| This #107 repair | `SquareKit/Internal/DependentJudgments/PresentedElimination.lean`, `PresentedSquares.lean`, `SourcePath.lean`, `SourcePathArguments.lean`, `TelescopeAuthoring.lean`, `TelescopeTransport.lean`; `LeftConcatenationSubstitution.lean`, `LeftAssociativity.lean`, `LeftTransportComposition.lean`; the four GuardedLeft examples named above | New repair work. Source conversions and selected interpretation comparisons are derived internally; new recipes can still need fresh-substitution lemmas. |
| Adopted guarded boundary and finite-tail presentation laws | `SquareKit/Internal/DependentJudgments/ContextualRules.lean`, `TelescopePresentation.lean`; `Examples/GuardedContextualJudgments.lean` | Other work available before this resumed repair, absent from the original #106 snapshot. The repair uses this existing named theory, not new logical rules. |
| Independent reference calculus and its comparison | `Examples/ReferenceDependentCalculus.lean`; `docs/research/reference-dependent-calculus.md` | Other work, not an automatic reverse translation or a universal adequacy result. |
| Ordinary model and retained original source clients | `Examples/GroupoidTransport.lean`, `Examples/GroupoidRoutes.lean`; `SquareKit/Internal/PathTransport/` | Original first-proof route retained, with later route/generalization work. Their availability does not repair legacy annotation comparisons automatically. |
| Bounded higher/cubical interpretations | `Examples/TwoFamilyStructuralModel.lean`, `Examples/CubicalSourceIdentity.lean`, and related public examples | Other work added after #106; each fragment and preservation contract still applies. These are not a general Agda importer. |
| Bounded elaboration/checking | `Applications/Elaboration/Syntax.lean`, `Elaborator.lean`, `Examples.lean`; `docs/research/bounded-elaboration.md` | Other work added after #106; fixed-sort elaboration does not provide general dependent-source elaboration or contextual-J coherence. |
| Source corpus and inspection | `experiments/dependent-higher-identity/Monodromy.agda`, `FrozenMemo.agda`; `docs/research/agda-internal-retention.md`; `experiments/agda-internal-retention/` | The higher source corpus predates this resumed repair; #115's inspection is separate work included in this snapshot. Inspection is not source admission or a completed semantic exporter. |

The authoritative experiment protocol remains the current #108 body, including its ten-cycle checkpoint, at most two full fresh validation invocations after successful construction, theorem exclusions, equivalent-statement/preparation check, distinct evaluator and archive-before-feedback requirement. This handoff does not replace or relax that protocol. The separate solution-free scope check must inspect the selected theorem against the entire permitted public corpus, not merely this inventory.
